description: Reduce redundant work in the n=512 low-rank complement build on shapes 3 (dense512 ~76ms) and 8 (rankdef512 ~87ms). brief-54 found their Qd-projection GEMMs R=R-Qd(Qd^T R) are the last sizable FP32-SIMT ops but plain 3xTF32 loses there (small nc). Instead fuse the projection with the CholeskyQR2 pass to cut the intermediate R materialization and its two GEMMs into fewer larger ops, and fold the A@Qd matvec reuse across the power-iteration and Rayleigh steps so A@Qd is computed once not twice. Pure torch, redundant-work + access-pattern; per-matrix residual-gated.

t1: fuse complement-projection subtract into baddbmm epilogue. _lr_project_out uses torch.baddbmm(X,Qd,QtX,beta=1,alpha=-1) to fuse X-Qd@(Qd^T@X) into the GEMM epilogue (one kernel, no intermediate) vs bmm-then-elementwise-subtract; mode-aware (fp32/tf32 single baddbmm; 3xtf32/2xtf32 fold subtract into first Ozaki term). Bit-identical math. geomean 29757 (~parent 29707, flat). nsys shape8 confirms CUDAFunctor_add 28->26 inst (projection subtracts fused) but net flat (baddbmm reads X in epilogue). 39/39 valid, stream=0.

t2: REMOVE the n*n AV column-gather; gate on precomputed residual. _lowrank_eigh forms Res=AV-V*lam on the UNORDERED triple and returns Res instead of AV; the gate's ord=1 matrix norm is column-permutation-invariant (perm preserves the multiset of column sums -> max unchanged) and Res is never returned, so only V and lam need the sort-gather for the ascending-eigenvalue output. The AV scatter_gather (~0.5ms/shape on 3/8) is gone. Math-identical gate decision (proved perm-invariance for both eig and orth). geomean 29733. shape3 -0.54%, shape8 -0.51%, shape6 +0.03% (intact). 39/39 valid, stream=0.

t3 (HEAD): build gate residual BLOCK-WISE, removing the AV cat. Res=cat([AVd-Vd*lam_d, AVc-Vc*lam_c]) instead of cat([AVd,AVc]) then one subtract -- bit-identical, removes AV=cat CatArrayBatchedCopy. nsys shape8 confirms scatter_gather 3->2 inst (AV gather gone, -503k ns). Net-neutral vs t2 (cat is small; 2nd subtract offsets). geomean 29786 (~t2 29733, within 1% noise). WHAT I REMOVED (measured, profile-confirmed on shape8 nsys):
1. t2 (the win): the n*n AV column-GATHER. _lowrank_eigh now forms the eigen-residual Res=AV-V*lam on the UNORDERED triple and returns Res (not AV). Proved the gate's ord=1 matrix-norm (both eig AND orth=V^TV-I) is INVARIANT to a column permutation, and Res is never returned -> only V,lam need the sort-gather. nsys: scatter_gather 3->2 inst, -503k ns/shape (~0.5% shape8, ~0.6% shape3). This is the source of the -0.4..0.7% on shapes 3/8.
2. t1: projection subtract fused into baddbmm epilogue (X-Qd@(Qd^T@X) -> baddbmm one kernel, mode-aware incl 3xtf32/2xtf32). Bit-identical; net FLAT (baddbmm reads X in epilogue, cancels the removed elementwise-add).
3. t3: block-wise residual removes the AV=cat materialization. Bit-identical; FLAT.

MEASURED FINDINGS on the brief's two other levers (both turned out NON-redundant here -- report, not verdict):
* Brief point 2 (REUSE A@Qd across power+Rayleigh): already NON-redundant in the parent. The A@Qd at line ~2399 (feeding Bk and AVd=AQd@G) uses the FINAL orthonormalized Qd; the power loop's last matvec was A@Qd_prev (the PRE-orthonormalization Qd). Since Qd_new=CQR2(A@Qd_prev)=A@Qd_prev@M, computing A@Qd_new needs A^2@Qd_prev (a fresh matvec), NOT reusable. AQd is already computed ONCE and reused for both Bk and AVd (parent line ~2399 comment confirms). So no redundant A@Qd exists to remove.
* Brief point 1 (fuse projection with CQR2 Gram / fewer-larger GEMMs): the projections are algebraically a NO-OP in exact arithmetic (after proj1, Qd^T@R_proj=0 exactly, so proj2 only removes CQR2's ~3e-4 fp DRIFT -- a genuine numerical safeguard, not redundant recompute). The CQR2's internal inverse-Chol factor M is not a hoistable GEMM. Reformulating the 2nd CQR2 Gram as G=Vc1^T Vc1 - W^T W is exact but Vc1^T Vc1 costs the SAME n-contraction as Vc2^T Vc2 (no save). Forming the projector QdQd^T to share across both projections is MORE flops for small nc (n>k: 176M vs 115M/matrix on shape3). So the factored 2-GEMM projection is already flop-optimal and the projection GEMMs are irreducible without precision (brief says 3xTF32 loses at small nc -- confirmed by brief-54) or algorithm change (both brief-forbidden).

BIGGEST REMAINING OUTER COST is NOT redundant: batch_trsm_left (CQR2 triangular solve) is 16.6% shape3 / 14.9% shape8 -- the orthonormalizer itself (dominant CQR2 + 2 complement CQR2 passes). brief-44 already found it resists precision tricks. The FP32-SIMT projection GEMM ntn 128x128x16 (Qd^T@X, contracting over n) is 6.3% shape3 / 3.2% shape8.

OPEN DIRECTIONS (need a DIFFERENT brief -- they change math/algorithm, which THIS brief forbids, so I did not pursue them):
(a) Reduce the FIRST complement CQR2 (line ~2479) from 2-pass to 1-pass, mirroring the range-finder's justified 1-pass (it only conditions R for proj2, doesn't need gate accuracy; the FINAL CQR2 must stay 2-pass per brief-54 t5). Removes 1 Gram+1 chol+1 trsm/complement-build. ALGORITHM change (alters Vc numerics) -> needs reseed gate re-verification; my reseed harness (/tmp/reseed_check.py) is ready to gate it.
(b) A structurally-different orthonormalizer that avoids the trsm (fused Newton-Schulz keeping the ill-conditioned complement orthonormal, or a batched-trsm-as-GEMM) -- brief-44/brief-48 already probed pieces of this (brief-48's fused WMMA trsm LOST to cuBLAS batch_trsm_left). 
(c) The gate's V^TV 3xtf32 Gram (orth check, full n*n*n) is the other big outer GEMM -- orthogonal to the complement build.

RECOMMENDATION: the redundant-work surface for the n=512 complement build is thin -- the one clean win (AV-gather removal, kept in HEAD) is ~-0.5% on shapes 3/8 and safe. The projection GEMMs / trsm that DOMINATE are genuine work, not recompute, so further gains here need the precision or algorithm departures this brief excluded. Rotate me to (a) [1-pass first complement CQR2, algorithm brief with reseed gating] or to a trsm-elimination brief (b) if the manager wants to keep pushing shapes 3/8; the AV-gather win in HEAD is a clean bankable delta to keep regardless.
